title: additiveLoft
body:
## additiveLoft

Add material through an ordered list of at least two closed Body-owned section profiles. It may start the Body or join the current base. ruled gives straight ruled spans; otherwise the native loft interpolates smoothly. Sections retain their placements/attachments and the result must be one valid positive-volume solid.

Native binding: `PartDesign::AdditiveLoft`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `sections` | nonempty list | yes | `profile` |
| `base` | one node | no | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ruled` | False (default) interpolates a smooth loft between sections; true uses straight ruled spans. Incompatible profiles and self-intersection remain native geometry failures. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
